title: The Heavenly Threat of One Mosquito
body:
Dastoor, yaa rijaalAllah! Allahu akbar kabeera wal hamdulillahi katheera wa subhanaallahi bukratan wa
`aseelah.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar la ilaaha illa-Llah Allahu akbar wa lillahi 'l-hamd! `Azhami 'l-khalq, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s) Ya rabbee zidhu sharafan wa `izzan wa nooran wa farhan wa surooran. Madad, yaa Sultaanu
'l-Awliya.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
As-salaamu `alaykum yaa `ibaadullah. As-salaamu `alaykum to whom are asking to listen to something.
Marhaban, marhaban! Yaa saahib al-waqt! Yaa saahib as-zamaan! Grant us your permission, give us your
holy permission for khitaab, for declaration. A declaration for whole human nature. Yes. We are weak
servants; therefore, we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Weakness is coming to
people from Shaytan. He is trying to make people unable to do anything; if asking to do something, Shaytan's
mission is to change it in another way, to always make Mankind on wrong way. He can't do, he is never going

to do anything, but as the signs of the Last Day, Yawm ul-Qiyamah, should appear so many signs that
Judgment Day is approaching. I hope for the barakah, blessings of blessed ones who are making an old, weak
servant to speak to whole nations through east and west. I know nothing. I am asking first for forgiveness
from the Lord of Heavens, Allah (swt), (Mawlana Shaykh stands) and second, asking intercession from the
beloved Seal of Prophets, most beloved, most glorified one, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
That is for our nation, making through a weak servant to address to whole nations as a last chance for them
to think, are their steps true steps or wrong steps? I am weakest servant, and according to high order of the
Seal of Prophets, according to commands of Heavens, I am saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem,
bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Heavenly
swords come on the heads of those people to stop heavenly declarations! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) They are
fearing, those people whom they are asking to stop declaration of truth. I am asking and I am ashaming to
address to our Lord, “O Allah, send on them pig flu!” Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah,
astaghfirullah! (Mawlana Shaykh laughs.) My whole promise, they are ashaming to say!
Sayyidina Ibraheem (a), peace be upon the Seal of Prophets (s) and peace be upon Sayyidina Ibraheem; he
was never asking, “O my Lord, send mosquitoes on Nimrod’s soldiers!” Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah,
astaghfirullah, a million times astaghfirullah! He was such a Khaleel ur-Rahmaan (Friend of the Most
Merciful) that he cannot ask, “O my Lord, send on those armies of Nimrod mosquitoes to take them away.”
Can’t be! Therefore, I am angry at Salafi `ulamas, as they are never running to an opening of the meanings,
and what power through the words coming from heavens! They are not trying to understand, (they are
making that knowledge) down.
Ibraheem Khaleelullah was never asking for mosquitoes to be sent down on Nimrod's armies, only he was
saying, “O my Lord! That is a bad servant who is following his egoistic demands, claiming he is king on this
world, and You know he is coming for fighting. He is not understanding Who are You, O my Lord. You know,
and I don’t know how You are going to deal with them. I am never asking from You how to deal with those
people, because they are also Your servants. Only I can say, I am here, and that one is a bad servant, only
asking to fight with his armies. He is thinking that You are an ordinary one, that sending only armies of one
king to fight with armies of another king.”

Allah (swt) is answering, “O Ibraheem! Keep your center. Don’t fear, I am the Lord of Heavens. Only look
what I am sending. According to his understandings, I am only sending some weak armies.”
Allah Almighty didn't use His divine powers. If Allah Almighty is sending (harsh) weather, or if (people stop)
breathing, or if sending Archangel Israfeel and people look to him like this, they are finished, coming down!
But Allah Almighty looked to them and sent mosquitoes on those armies, because Nimrod must understand
he can’t carry something (more powerful) than divine power. Therefore, sending to him mosquitoes that if
you breathe them, finishing. They were coming (on that army) and their coming was so terrible, so terrible!
Now people are so happy and so proud with their supersonic (weapons) faster than the speed of sound, and
(Allah Almighty was) making each mosquito to bring that sound. At that time no one was knowing that huge
sound coming from supersonic. SubhaanAllah. Beginning to come and (the big sound was like) wuuuuu,
wuuuuuu and first one coming, Allah, Allah, Allahu akbar.
Yes, we are saying, bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem that some people are unhappy to hear from Reality;
they are jealous! Either they are min junuud Iblees, from the armies of Iblees, or sadanas, Shaytan. Yes, they
are not fearing from Allah and they're trying to reach to people through evil! The kamaal, perfection of Man,
is to be clean from bad egoistic characteristics. Now some people are working for Shaytan, and we are not
asking from Allah Almighty, "O our Lord, kill them." Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah. No. During the Battle of
Uhud, angels came to Sayyidi 'r-Rasulu 'l-kiraam (s), saying, “Let us take over those no-mind mushrik
armies,” and he answered, "No, I cannot accept that:
••••••••••• ••••••• •••••••••• ••••••••••
fa 'l-hukum lil-Lahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-kabeer, the command is with Allah Most High, the Greatest. (40:12)
Now there are some jealous people who are Shaytan's assistants, Shaytan giving to them a graduate degree to
be doctor from satanic academy! They can't carry even to hear something that they are not understanding,
because their understanding is in limits. Holy Qur'an coming to make our understanding wider, wider, wider,
up to Lam yazal wa laa yazaal, from pre-Eternity up to Eternity! But people are under their egoistic
characteristics, carrying them to be with Shaytan, not to be Allah Almighty's servants. We don't like a person
to step on wrong step, no. Therefore, they are making me to speak. I don't know. Therefore, it is blame for
prophets and awliyaullah to ask to send on them punishment from heavens or from Earth. How they are not
fearing? And they (some people) are asking from Allah Almighty if they can kill people if they are not

following wrong ways! But those who are true ones, asta'aidh billah! (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••• •••••••••• •••• •••••••••••
Yaa ayyuhal ladheena `aamanoo ittaqoollah wa koonoo ma` as-saadiqeen; O ye who believe! Fear Allah and
be with those who are true (in word and deed). (9:119)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.) I am asking to those Salafi `ulamas, my Lord is making me to ask you about that holy
verse, ordering, “O My servants, be with true ones, sadiqeen." I am asking, who are the true ones you are
following now?! Don't say "Ibn Qayyim, Ibn Taymiyya, Muhammad ibn Abdul-Wahhab." I am asking to find
a new one! Show me! You are saying, “I am following you.” If not showing me a true one, you are responsible!
You are `asee, disobedient ones! Yes, Salafi `ulamas, I am shouting to them, to make realities clear so that
whole nation of Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) to be clear. If I am wrong, come
and do what you can do for me! But I can do something for you, up to morning!! Yes, I am not against those
people, but I am against baatil, falsehood.
Haatoo burhanakum, bring your proof, I am here! If not (bringing proof), don’t attack me! I am now weakest
creature, but sometimes weakest creature may take your soul away! That's why I was saying they are not
fearing from Allah or from awliyaa, but they are fearing from pig flu! Ptuuh, ptuuh, ptuuh (spit) on those
people who are not fearing from Allah Almighty, blaming from Seal of Prophets (s)!
We are not Arab, we are all aa`jim. Therefore whole Sahaba-i-kiraam are qurayshiyyan aw `arabiyyan. You
are bringing to our countries and we are keeping and giving high respect to everything that you are bringing,
and we are kissing your hands, kissing your heads. What happened? Everything that you are saying, haatoo
burhaanakum, bring your proof! If you are not bringing, the Lord of Heavens is looking and seeing you, and
hearing you, and reaching to you. Yes, correct? Fear Allah! Fear Allah! No one can save you if sent on you that
pig flu, that virus. From one mosquito perhaps a billion or more viruses coming.
Is our Lord not, ••••• •••••• •••• ••• •••••• kulla yawmin Huwa fee shaan, (every day in (new) Splendour doth
He (shine)! (55:29)
Shaanullah wa laa waahid y`arif shaanahu, (No one comprehends His reality). What no one is knowing,
whole mutassarrif, heavenly administrative authorities (are in charge of) everything happening through

Creation. Allah Almighty creating one and giving that mutassarrif such an authority to use and command that
virus, "Leave pigs and run after those people!" Haasha, Heaven forbid! Allah Almighty is sending, one who is
controlling this world and everything on it, on behalf of the Seal of Prophets (s), (who is khalifatullah), yes,
His weakest servant may order that virus to those no-mind servants of Shaytan, to run on them and scare
them! Finished!
To whom is that power coming? Coming through Qutb al-Mutassarif on this planet. You must believe! If not
believing, he (Qutb al-Mutassarif) may send on you one virus and up to morning, finished (you will die)! I am
not against anyone; I am only against Shaytan and his servants. I am only weak servant, but you are so proud,
saying, “We are Salafi `ulamas," so proud! Saying:
•••••••• ••••••• ••••••• •••• ••••••••• •••••••••••
Innamaa yakhsallaha min `ibaadihi l-`ulama; It is only those who have knowledge among His slaves that fear
Allah. (35:28)
Khashiy `indakum kam marrah nadhartum li 'n-nisaa? Kam marra tadayafoon nufoosikum? kam marrah
takooloon habsa an-nafs min shahawaatiha, (do you have fear of Allah? How many times you are looking at
women? How many times you are putting forward your egoes? How many times are you not holding your ego
from its desires?) Say! Say! Don't make that weakest servant to do something, ... but if you believe or don't
believe, they may send on you punishment. May Allah forgives us!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Everyone fears, I am saying and laughing, that people are not fearing from Allah Almighty but they are
fearing from pig flu! What you are saying Salafi `ulamas? Innamaa yakhshallaha min `ibaadihi' l-`ulama.
Say! Don't be angry. If you get angry, my anger is not like your anger. Who are making me to declare from
east to west, they are putting that anger and making me to say! I am weakest servant, but I am under
command of heavenly ones.
Dome Dome, Dome Dome 4x

At morning time, you can stand up like this, and at nighttime you may be like (Mawlana Shaykh gestures,
thumbs down). You may understand what I am saying to you.
Huuuuuuu, Huuuuuu 4x
May Allah forgives us. Fatihah.
(40 minutes)
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Shaykh Hisham on the phone.)
